tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures and raw histories support a coupled transient memory mechanism, but the five observations do not adequately identify its four parameters. Acquire the trajectory batch before fitting and fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Coupled memory-kernel ODE fitted to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Four coupled parameters and the latent memory reconstructed from irregular prefixes are insufficiently identified by five closely related rows; the archived mechanism calls for at least eight.
The observed history dependence and coupled transient lag favor the memory mechanism over a static sink-gradient branch; extra trajectory observations target the present ambiguity more directly.
It does not resolve the memory dynamics.
